name: Variant → batch bifurcation for inventory report.
description: Variant → batch bifurcation for inventory report. Part of the Inventory APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

Auth-Key.description: Company auth key. Send this or Session-Id. One is required.

Session-Id.description: Logged-in user session. Send this or Auth-Key. One is required.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 50. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: closing_quantity. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

param.description: Param. Allowed values: CLOSING_QTY, QTY_CR, QTY_DR, RATE, AMT_CR, AMT_DR. Optional.

voucherTypes.description: Array of voucher types values. Allowed values: PURCHASE, PURCHASE_DEBIT_NOTE, PURCHASE_CREDIT_NOTE, SALES, SALES_DEBIT_NOTE, SALES_CREDIT_NOTE, MANUFACTURED, RAW_MATERIAL, RECEIPT_NOTE, DELIVERY_NOTE, CREDIT_NOTE, DEBIT_NOTE, JOURNAL. Optional.

branchUniqueNames.description: Array of branch unique names values. Optional.

warehouseUniqueNames.description: Array of warehouse unique names values. Optional.

variantUniqueNames.description: Array of variant unique names values. Optional.

batchUniqueNames.description: Array of batch unique names values. Optional.

batchNumbers.description: Array of batch numbers values. Optional.

stockUniqueNames.description: Array of stock unique names values. Optional.

stockGroupUniqueNames.description: Array of stock group unique names values. Optional.

inventoryType.description: Inventory type. Allowed values: PRODUCT, SERVICE, FIXED_ASSETS. Optional.

archived.description: When true, applies the archived filter or flag. Optional.
